title: Distributed Locks
text: Let's explore distributed locking. Here we will be implementing locks across distributed systems. A distributed lock is a mechanism that ensures mutual exclusion of shared resources across multiple nodes in a distributed system. Mutual exclusion is a property of concurrency control, which is instituted to prevent race conditions. It states that no two processes may simultaneously enter their critical section. It is the basic requirement for successfully implementing critical sections
